top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and the identification of its active form form a mature, mechanistically stable discovery chain (incretin effect, proglucagon processing, active peptide, receptor biology) that led to incretin therapies with confirmed benefit in type 2 diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The Drucker, Holst and Mojsov allocation with a physiology-centred citation rewards the discovery and not the drug programme. Unsettled priority for the active form and the omission of Knudsen are real costs, but they qualify the award and do not outweigh a clearly award-worthy achievement, so P001 is ranked above no award.
